units: <cite ref="Eruvin 77b:2">Erub. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>דבעי מ׳ וחצינא</he> it requires hoe or pick-axe (to get it out).
<cite ref="Taanit 23b:14">Taan. 23ᵇ</cite> top <he>ציבי ומ׳</he> the wood (he had collected) and the rake.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 82b:2">B. Mets. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ ופסל וקרדום</he> (Ms. <he>מר</he>, Ar. <he>מר פסל</he>) hoe and mattock and axe; <cite ref="Berakhot 57b:22">Ber. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>מר פסל וקרדום</he>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 64a:6">Keth. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>בעינא</he> … <he>ומָרָה לקבורה</he> I want a staff to lean on and a hoe to make my grave, i.e. a son to support me in old age and to provide for my burial; <cite ref="Yevamot 65b:18">Yeb. 65ᵇ</cite>.

senses.gloss: (= מארא, denom. of אוּרָא; cmp. Arab. marvu silices &c.) flint for striking a light.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 116b:3">Zeb. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>אפיקו נורא ממ׳ חדתא</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="M00105"><he>ממַגָּאנָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 579:5">Yalk. Lev. 579</cite> <cite ref="M00193"><he>ממַגָּנָה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="M01710"><he>מַנְגָּנָא</he></cite>; Ms. K. <cite ref="M00048"><he>ממָאנָא</he></cite>; En Yaăk. <he>ממָנָא</he>) produce fire with a flint-stone which has not been used before.
